One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he’s drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins. PSYREN is now streaming on Crunchyroll!

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Resident Evil Requiem's DLC plans reportedly feature a story centered around series villain Oswell E. Spencer. At least, that's according to RE9's writer, Haris Orkin, who said that Capcom has already begun working on DLC. Game director Koshi Nakanishi also confirmed that a major story expansion is planned for Requiem. In other news, Forza Horizon 6's PS5 debut will happen January 26, 2027. The release will reportedly be supported by a physical PS5 disc launch.

Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Writer Teases DLC Spencer Arc - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Check out the new Progression trailer for the DMZ mode included in Modern Warfare 4. The mode has been signficantly retooled since Modern Warfare 2, introducing the F.O.B (Forward Operating Base) where you can spend skill points to upgrade your operator, use cash to purchase weaponry and customise weapons. Using materials and cash, you can upgrade your vendor stations, letting you craft improved gear for use in the field. 

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Progression Trailer

author: IGN
description: For a book that's over fifty years old, Prime Video's Carrie feels incredibly timely. IGN's Tom Jorgensen sat down with showrunner Mike Flanagan and the cast of Carrie to discuss why the TV format fits the story so well, and how the updates to Stephen King's original text were enough to convince the Master of Horror to get on board with a new take on the telekinetic teen's story after years of saying "she's been through enough."
title: "We're Presenting The Anti-Carrie" | How Mike Flanagan Updated Carrie For The 21st Century
